'''Mare Tino (VSC) WYS with (V) Luke''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mare Tino]]
* '''Published:''' 28 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Strategy:''' Watch Your Step
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 WYS Tino LS 2002 VSCWYSwi.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

WYS with retrieval and force loss limiting.

== Strategy ==

Just your average defensive WYS.

- Setup WYS.

- Use Luke to retrieve or get AWRI&DS.;

- Setup Menace Fades

- Limit DS drains with PoaS/ICBW/IAH!

- and/or go for the drain on Kessel if possible

If you don't like the [V] Fusion Generator Supply Tanks exchange it for a Ralltiir Freighter Captain. Plus one maneuver to all my starships helps against cannons and cancelling Lateral Damage is good news for Dash.

Martijn Peeters
